jobs.description_text: As our MEP Coordinator, you will lead the delivery of high‑quality commercial construction projects by supporting the planning, coordination, and commissioning of mechanical, electrical, plumbing, and low‑voltage systems. In this role, you will ensure that building systems operate as intended by managing compliance requirements, supporting building automation integration, and overseeing testing, startup, and closeout activities across fast‑paced project environments. You will collaborate closely with project managers, superintendents, subcontractors, and design teams to ensure that all MEP work aligns with project drawings, specifications, commissioning plans, and owner requirements. You will also support the documentation, verification, and turnover processes necessary for high‑functioning and fully compliant building systems. Experienced coordinators may take on more complex systems integration responsibilities, lead commissioning meetings, work directly with owners and facility teams, assist in resolving field‑driven MEP challenges, and support continuous improvement in project execution. Successful team members in this role are committed to accuracy, system performance, safety, problem‑solving, and delivering excellent results throughout construction and commissioning.

Working across brand and communications, the team creates work that connects with audiences around the world. We're looking for a Global Creative Lead to shape the visual direction of Reverb and lead a talented team of graphic designers, motion designers, and producers. You'll combine creative vision with hands-on leadership, helping the team deliver distinctive, high-quality work while building an environment where people can collaborate, experiment, and grow. As Head of Artist & Label Product, you’ll lead the product organization responsible for these experiences, bringing together our artist and label products into a clear, connected strategy. You’ll lead PM managers and senior PMs, set direction across multiple product areas, and turn that strategy into meaningful outcomes for artists, labels, listeners, and Spotify. As Legal Counsel, Litigation, you will work on a variety of litigation, copyright, patent, and other contentious and advisory matters, and help craft the way our company thinks about and handles them. jobs.title: Senior Mechanical Engineer
jobs.description_text: Skyways designs, builds, and operates fully autonomous long-range cargo aircraft. Founded in 2017, the company has spent the last eight years developing and deploying autonomous logistics systems for real-world operations. Our V2 aircraft carries 30 lbs up to 500 miles, and V3 has a maximum range of well over 1,000 miles, a maximum useful load of 100 lbs, and a maximum endurance of nearly 20 hours. Both use a hybrid-electric architecture that takes off like a helicopter and cruises like a plane, enabling long-range autonomous delivery without traditional runway infrastructure. Today, Skyways aircraft operate across three continents in controlled national airspace under FAA oversight and in support of U.S. military operations. We are transitioning from prototype development to full-rate production and scaling toward large autonomous cargo fleets. Backed by Y Combinator and a $37M AFWERX STRATFI award from the U.S. Air Force, Skyways is creating a new form of transportation to advance our civilization from Austin, Texas.

jobs.title: Product Development Co-op
jobs.description_text: In the Product Development Co-op role, you work closely with other members of our Product Development Team on all phases of the product development process—researching, designing, manufacturing, and refining the highest-quality hand tools. We view the work of our Co-op program as an integral part of our full-time Product Development Team. You will join an existing project team in your first rotation and quickly be asked to contribute to the development project(s) underway. In later rotations, you will be asked to lead full development projects, or at least substantial portions of them.

jobs.title: Head of Autonomy
jobs.description_text: The Role The Head of Autonomy owns Teleo's autonomy stack end to end and leads the team that builds it. You will lead the engineering team across perception, simulation, controls, path planning, fleet orchestration, learning-based methods (RL, imitation learning, and VLA-style models), and MLOps. This is a senior player-coach role. You will set the technical direction, make the architecture calls, and stay close enough to the code and the field data to review designs in depth. You will also hire, grow, and run the team, and be accountable for autonomy performance on customer deployments across several machine types. The core technical problem is taking a stack that works today in supervised autonomy on real job sites and scaling it: more machine types, more sites, more material-manipulation tasks, and fewer operator interventions per hour, without compromising safety. Took an autonomy product from prototype to multi-site commercial deployment Led autonomy work on defense programs Scaled a team through a period of fast growth

jobs.title: Lead Manufacturing Engineer
jobs.description_text: About the Role We are looking for a Lead Manufacturing Engineer, Contract Manufacturing, to sit at the intersection of Teleo engineering and contract manufacturing, supporting our autonomy retrofit kits from prototype through a stable transition to CM, and owning production from there. You'll collaborate with Teleo's cross-functional engineering, operations and PM teams on internal prototyping and manufacturing-process development, then own the handoff to the CM and shift into overseeing CM delivery, cost, and quality — acting as the primary point of contact when issues arise at the CM.

jobs.title: Mechanical Engineer, Vehicle Integration & Product Design
jobs.description_text: Role Summary As a Mechanical Engineer, you will design and integrate vehicle-specific brackets, mounts, and mechanical interfaces for Teleo’s autonomy retrofit system across a wide range of heavy equipment platforms. You will also contribute to core product improvements that make our system more reliable, manufacturable, and easier to install in the field. We are looking for an engineer who is hands-on, rigorous, and detail-oriented. Someone who is not afraid to work directly on heavy construction equipment, take measurements in the field, and turn those observations into fast, well-thought-out, robust designs. You should enjoy solving real-world mechanical problems, iterating quickly, and taking ownership from design through installation. This is a prime opportunity to join Teleo at a time of rapid growth, with a direct impact on how we scale our technology across new vehicle platforms and sites. It is also an excellent opportunity to grow into broader, multidisciplinary, system-level integration work.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Integration
jobs.description_text: Teleo, a Havoc company, is a robotics company that transforms construction heavy equipment, including loaders, dozers, excavators, and trucks, into autonomous robots for commercial and defense applications. Our technology enables a single operator to supervise and control multiple machines simultaneously, delivering significant productivity gains while improving operator safety and comfort. Teleo was founded by a team of experienced technology leaders who previously led the development of Lyft's Self-Driving Car program and Google Street View. Teleo recently announced its merger with Havoc AI, a fast-growing defense technology company developing coordinated fleets of autonomous maritime vessels. This is a unique opportunity to join a team building technology with real-world impact. You will work on cutting-edge 100,000-pound autonomous robots and engineer complex systems at the intersection of hardware, software, robotics, and AI. Mission Own the integration of Teleo's autonomy and vehicle subsystems into a reliable, cohesive platform. Bridge the gap between independently developed components — perception, controls, networking, hardware interfaces — and make them work together on real hardware.

jobs.title: Human Aware Interactions and Learning Intern
jobs.description_text: This is a paid 12-week internship opportunity and is a hybrid, in-office role. Here’s a glimpse into the Internship experience from some of our TRI interns! The Mission We are working to create general-purpose robots capable of accomplishing a wide variety of dexterous tasks with humans. To do this, our team is exploring how Large Behavior Models and other general-purpose machine learning models use generative AI techniques to produce robot actions from sensor data and human interactions. We use both simulation and human-interactive data to augment real-world robot data towards such embodied AI policies. jobs.title: Account Executive
jobs.description_text: About Tutor We believe robots will be the next chapter in making physical labor safer and more affordable. Our robot Cassie does back-breaking work, moving boxes, pallets, and bulk goods for family-owned manufacturers to some of the largest brands in the world. Our mission is grand: robots everywhere, for the common good, raising the standard of living across North America, and then the world.

But, nearly nine out of ten American factories and warehouses don’t have a single robot. Tutor Intelligence is changing that. We build robots that go straight into real factories and warehouses, to do real work, with real impact. Our robot Cassie does back-breaking work, moving boxes, pallets, and bulk goods for family-owned manufacturers to some of the largest brands in the world. Our robot Sonny does handwork, using two arms to achieve human-like dexterity in picking and packing. Every robot learns on the job, and each one we deploy makes the next one more capable, more affordable, and faster to put to work. Founded at MIT and headquartered in Watertown, MA, we do it all in-house: the robotics hardware, the machine learning, and the field deployment and service. We’re a team of researchers, engineers, technicians, operators, and sellers who love building things and solving hard problems. Our mission is grand: robots everywhere, for the common good, raising the standard of living across North America, and then the world. Competitive base salary + commission (OTE) and full benefits

You will challenge conventional approaches, anticipate emerging threats, and leverage technologies such as artificial intelligence to build scalable, intelligent security capabilities. This role calls for a bold thinker and hands-on strategist who thrives in complexity, can influence the executive level, and knows how to translate security investments into meaningful business value. jobs.title: Deputy Political Research Director
jobs.description_text: Americans for Prosperity (AFP) is the premier grassroots organization focused on advocating solutions to the country’s greatest challenges. We recognize that tens of millions of Americans are frustrated with the extreme partisanship in government that keeps common-sense reforms from being passed, and instead seek to stand with policy leaders who are committed to finding a better way. Americans for Prosperity is part of the Stand Together philanthropic community. Help elect policy champions. As Deputy Political Research Director at Americans for Prosperity (AFP), you'll work alongside the Political Research Director to lead a team that researches and vets the policy positions of current and prospective candidates. Your work will span gubernatorial, state legislative, congressional, and Senate races. You'll partner with teams across the organization to build vetting strategies that identify candidates who will advance AFP's policy priorities. Your team will also create research products that inform other key organizational strategies.

jobs.title: Enterprise Architecture & Data Leader

As a member of the technology leadership team, you will establish and lead our enterprise architecture and data function, setting the direction for how systems connect, data is shared, and technology decisions are made. You will create architectural foundations, trusted data models, and reusable solutions that empower teams to move faster, innovate with confidence, and deliver greater value. We are looking for a leader who sees architecture as an enabler of innovation, not a barrier to progress — someone who combines deep technical expertise, sound business judgment, and an entrepreneurial mindset to build what comes next. For this role, the anticipated base salary range is $210,000–$250,000per year.

jobs.title: KIP Spring 2027 - Programs & Events Intern - America's Future
jobs.description_text: About America's Future America's Future is the talent accelerator and professional network for classically liberal young professionals. Through training, leadership development, and community, we equip rising leaders with the skills, experiences, and network they need to become effective, principled champions of liberty in their careers and communities. Find Your People. Build Your Future. Learn more about us by visiting our website! About the role America's Future is looking for an intern to join our Washington, DC team this spring. You'll work at the center of two things we care about most: supporting the production of DC events, including our Annual Gala & Awards Showcase, and the fellowship programs and chapters that bring our community together year-round. This is a hands-on role for someone who wants to see how a nonprofit builds and delivers programs and events, from the first planning spreadsheet to the night itself. The intern will report to the Chief Operating Officer and support the needs of the full team. They will receive a travel stipend for the metro. Stand Together Fellowships pays participants a stipend of either $7,500 for full-time participants working approximately 32 hours per week at the partner organization, or $5,500 for part-time participants working approximately 24 hours per week at the partner organization. Attending the entirety of the online and on-site KIP programming is required for both full and part-time participants.

jobs.title: Political Scout Manager
jobs.description_text: Americans for Prosperity (AFP) is the premier grassroots organization focused on advocating solutions to the country’s greatest challenges. We recognize that tens of millions of Americans are frustrated with the extreme partisanship in government that keeps common-sense reforms from being passed, and instead seek to stand with policy leaders who are committed to finding a better way. Americans for Prosperity is part of the Stand Together philanthropic community. A senior, high-impact leadership role driving political strategy. This position sits at the center of Americans for Prosperity's political recruitment strategy — identifying, cultivating, and mentoring the next generation of policy-aligned leaders who will shape federal and state government. You'll work directly with senior state leadership, internal stakeholders, and high-profile political figures, making this a unique role contributing to AFP’s broader mission. The Political Scout Manager role calls for a seasoned political professional with a track record of leadership at the highest levels of campaign and recruitment work.

jobs.title: Security Manager
jobs.description_text: Stand Together's Security team seeks an experienced Security Manager to support the safety and security of its Washington, DC-based facility, events, personnel, and operations. This role implements comprehensive security measures, conducts risk assessments, coordinates executive protection, and ensures the effective execution of facility and event security programs. The ideal candidate brings strong protective services experience, sound judgment, and the ability to proactively identify risks and implement practical security solutions. As a key representative of the Security team, this individual will build trusted relationships with internal stakeholders, external partners, and government officials. Success in this role requires a high level of professionalism, emotional intelligence, discretion, and a service-oriented approach to security. This is a full-time, in-person position based at the Freedom Embassy in Washington, DC. Approximately 15% travel is expected in support of organizational initiatives and events. For this role, the anticipated base salary range is $100,000–$110,000 per year.

jobs.title: Senior Digital Campaign Manager – State Grassroots
jobs.description_text: As Senior Digital Campaign Manager with Stand Together Communications, you will own high-impact digital strategies that drive state legislative and brand objectives across a comprehensive portfolio of state chapters for the grassroots and policy/advocacy work at Americans for Prosperity, Concerned Veterans for America, and The LIBRE Initiative. This role requires an advanced strategic operator who can build trust with state leadership, management of large portfolios, and seamlessly balance hands-on campaign execution with long-term, portfolio-wide strategy. If you are a seasoned relationship builder who thrives in a fast-paced advocacy environment and can drive high-level vision with leadership while rolling up your sleeves to get the job done, we want to hear from you. *This role is located at our office in Arlington, VA. For this role, the anticipated base salary range is $90,000 –$125,000 per year.

jobs.title: Senior Vendor Manager
jobs.description_text: Stand Together seeks an experienced Senior Vendor Manager to strengthen its vendor management, strategic sourcing, and procurement approach, with a focus on SaaS and technology partnerships. The Senior Vendor Manager will oversee the full vendor management lifecycle, from sourcing and contract negotiations to performance management, risk mitigation, and relationship development. This individual will collaborate closely with cross-functional stakeholders to ensure vendor partnerships deliver measurable value, support business objectives, and maximize the impact of organizational resources. Serving as a senior individual contributor, this individual will play a key role in advancing the organization's vendor management function by developing scalable processes, influencing strategic decisions, optimizing spending, and driving continuous improvements that enhance operational efficiency and vendor performance. For this role, the anticipated base salary range is $130,000–$140,000 per year.

jobs.title: Technology Portfolio & Delivery Leader
jobs.description_text: As the Technology Portfolio & Delivery Leader, you will serve as a key member of the Technology Leadership Team, shaping how technology investments are prioritized, resources are allocated, and solutions are delivered across the enterprise. This is a unique opportunity to build a modern, AI-enabled portfolio and delivery capability that connects technology strategy to execution, accelerates innovation, and drives measurable business value. We're seeking a strategic, entrepreneurial leader who challenges conventional approaches, brings fresh thinking to complex challenges, and knows how to turn competing priorities into clear decisions and meaningful outcomes. You'll partner with senior business and technology leaders to transform workflows across the organization, remove barriers to execution, and empower teams to deliver their greatest contributions. For this role, the anticipated base salary range is $195,000–$235,000 per year.

jobs.title: Business Strategy & Operations Lead
jobs.description_text: This is a full-time role based at our headquarters in Denver, CO, reporting to the Chief Operating Officer. As a Strategy & Operations Lead, you will apply your skills to connecting Xcimer's strategic priorities to day-to-day execution by partnering with Program Management and the Chief of Staff to close the gap between decisions made in leadership reviews and what actually gets built, running the analysis that informs program and resource prioritization, and personally driving the rollout, training, and adoption of new operational processes across the company. You'll often be the connective tissue on initiatives that don't sit cleanly inside any one function, owning ambiguous, cross-functional problems end-to-end, from first framing through implementation, and handing off a clean, sustainable process rather than a one-time fix. We are looking for our operations leaders to apply their technical expertise, problem solving skills, and dedication to quality to positively impact the future of energy!

jobs.title: Control Systems Project Lead – Applied Science
jobs.description_text: As a Control Systems Project Lead – Applied Science , you will own the controls system of a major development program, starting with one of our large, multi-subsystem laser test facilities. Our Applied Science group delivers control systems that integrate advanced hardware to demonstrate cutting-edge science, and in this role you will design, implement, verify, and commission the control, data acquisition, and interlock systems that enable scientific experimentation. This is a hands-on individual contributor role with coordination responsibility: you will plan and assign sprint work to other team members, deliver software releases on schedule, work directly with system operators, and coordinate controls activities with the other engineering teams on the program. We are looking for an engineer who brings strong diagnostic thinking, test stand experience, and demonstrable software capability, along with the organization to keep a multi-team controls effort on track.

jobs.title: Cryophysicist
jobs.description_text: We are welcoming applicants for a Cryophysicist position on Xcimer’s Fill and Injection Station Team. The successful candidate will join a growing group of engineers and scientists aimed at developing the processes and technologies to build a first of its kind Inertial Fusion Energy fueling station for Xcimer’s fusion reactor plant. In this role, you will lead the experimental and theoretical design, characterization, and optimization of physical systems operating at ultra-low temperatures. You will manage relations and work closely with collaborators from national labs and universities to drive research objectives that will critically impact future system design and architecture. This is an entry- to mid-level role focused on experimental and theoretical R&D.

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description_text: As a Data Engineer, you will assist efforts to integrate and maintain critical data systems across engineering, manufacturing, and business operations. You’ll serve as a key technical contributor, participating in a cross-functional team to deliver tools and dashboards which extract useful answers from the data lake and empower daily decision-making at Xcimer. This is a hands-on role with broad impact, ideal for someone passionate about operational excellence and shaping the future of clean energy.

jobs.title: Director, Integrated Target Design
jobs.description_text: Xcimer Energy is advancing Inertial Fusion Energy (IFE) by combining decades of scientific progress with a breakthrough laser architecture designed for practical and scalable fusion power. Our mission is to deploy commercial fusion plants quickly enough to accelerate global decarbonization, and also reduc the cost of electricity. Backed by leading investors, Xcimer brings together experts in laser physics, fusion science, and advanced manufacturing with a proven history of rapid execution. With a uniquely positioned team and technology, we are urgently working to deliver clean, abundant fusion energy with the speed to address climate change. Please join us in building a future powered by laser driven inertial confinement fusion (ICF). As the Director of Integrated Target Design at Xcimer, you will lead the interdisciplinary group of scientists and engineers that optimize all aspects of target physics for our new laser architecture. Your main responsibilities will be to guide efforts in advanced simulations and experiments, as well as the recruitment, mentoring, and development of the team. As a technical expert, you will provide day-to-day guidance to your team and participate in cross-function discussions across ICF disciplines. In close partnership with the program leads, you will translate high-level priorities and objectives into actionable plans, and build the culture and collaborations needed to reach the highest possible levels of fusion performance. At Xcimer, you can

jobs.title: Director, Licensing & Regulatory Affairs
jobs.description_text: As the Director, Licensing & Regulatory Affairs, you will apply your skills to build and lead the Operations department that secures and maintains every license, permit, and regulatory approval Xcimer needs to site, build, and operate its facilities. You will own regulatory strategy, agency relationships, and the end-to-end management of license and permit applications, and you will run the compliance obligations system that keeps Xcimer in good standing once approvals are granted. You will partner closely with Engineering, which owns the technical and safety analyses that underpin our applications; your team makes sure that work becomes complete, on-time, well-received submittals and durable regulatory commitments. We are looking for our leaders to apply their expertise, problem solving skills, and dedication to quality to positively impact the future of energy!

jobs.title: Electro-Optical/Adaptive Optics Engineer
jobs.description_text: As an Electro-Optical / Adaptive Optics Engineer, you will work across simulation and hardware: helping develop wave-optics propagation models that predict what the beamline will do, writing and tuning the control algorithms that correct it, and aligning and operating the AO hardware that closes the loop. You will help specify next-generation AO components and work with vendors to build them, alongside a multidisciplinary team of optical, mechanical, controls, and software engineers developing the surrounding systems in parallel. Your work will directly contribute to improving beam quality, stability, and system performance, enabling the delivery of unprecedented laser capabilities for inertial fusion energy (IFE). We are looking for our engineers and scientists to apply their technical expertise, problem-solving skills, and dedication to quality to positively impact the future of energy!

jobs.title: Fluids and Auxiliaries Operations Lead
jobs.description_text: As the Fluids, Vacuum, and Cryogenic Operations Lead for our superlasers, you will own, and be accountable for, the proper operation of our superlaser fluids, vacuum, and cryogenic systems hardware. You and the other operations leads will receive requested experiments from the Xcimer science team and you will use your technical and operational expertise in fluids, vacuum, and cryogenic systems to develop the operations schedule for experiments, maintenance, and upgrades on these systems. You will lead engineers and technicians in completing this work – ensuring the fluids, vacuum, and cryogenic systems function when needed for tests. You will also lead post-experiment data reviews to confirm proper system function and determine if additional system work is needed ahead of the next experiments. You will assist with troubleshooting anomalies in the superlasers’ fluids, vacuum, and cryogenic systems. You will also disposition non-conformances and develop operational infrastructure related to the fluids, vaccum, and cryogenic systems such as: operating limits, operating procedures, preventative maintenance requirements, etc. During work on your systems, you will lead hands-on work, helping with the work and leading technicians and other engineers to successfully execute.

jobs.title: Head of PMO
jobs.description_text: Xcimer Energy is scaling from a single program into a diversified enterprise portfolio, anchored by our Inertial Fusion Energy (IFE) program — which represents the large majority of our work — and a growing Defense program with its own risk and access profile. The Head of PMO owns the vision, mandate, and operating model for Xcimer's enterprise Program Management Office: the governance, standards, tools, and talent that let every program, current and future, plan and deliver with discipline, without becoming the bottleneck to speed. This is a hub-and-spoke model. The Head of PMO has direct accountability for the enterprise Hub — its governance, standards, tools, reporting, and staff — and a dotted-line coordination relationship with the program managers embedded in Fusion and Defense (the spokes). The Program Leads for Fusion and Defense continue to own their programs end to end and report to the Executives; the PMO's job is to make sure they, and every future program, are supported by a common, high-quality practice rather than each reinventing one. You build trust quickly and create alignment across program leaders, functional leaders, and the Executive, even when their priorities and operating rhythms differ. You know how to introduce governance and standards in a way that improves speed, clarity, and accountability — not process for its own sake. You bring a relentless focus on execution quality: every initiative in the portfolio has clear ownership, practical milestones,

jobs.title: HVAC Technician
jobs.description_text: HVAC Technician performs preventative and corrective maintenance, troubleshoots, and services industrial HVAC systems. Technician performs tests and analysis of data to assure the proper functioning of equipment and provides recommendations as appropriate. Recommendations shall include remaining life expectancy, potential replacement and repair costs as well as business interruption risks. Must be well organized, communicate in a clear and professional manner with all visitors, colleagues and leaders.

jobs.title: IFE Program Director
jobs.description_text: This role is responsible for the overall program scope, technical integration, schedule, budget, risk management, and delivery of Xcimer’s IFE Program. The IFE Program Director coordinates multidisciplinary teams spanning fusion physics, targets, laser, chamber, fuel cycle, controls, infrastructure, and other support subsystems to ensure that individual workstreams converge into a coherent, achievable design and development roadmap. Working closely with company leadership and department directors, the Program Director establishes program priorities, allocates resources, resolves cross-functional issues, and drives timely, evidence-based decisions. The successful candidate combines technical understanding of fusion energy systems with demonstrated leadership in complex, multidisciplinary technology development programs and the ability to translate ambitious technical objectives into executable plans and measurable outcomes.

jobs.title: Maintenance Technician, Capacitor Manufacturing
jobs.description_text: As a Maintenance Technician, you will apply your skills to keep the wound film capacitor line at our Tucson, Arizona facility running safely and reliably — the winders, vacuum drying and impregnation systems, ovens, and test equipment that build the capacitors behind Xcimer's pulsed-power laser drivers. We are looking for our technicians to apply their technical expertise, problem solving skills, and dedication to quality to positively impact the future of energy!

jobs.title: Manager of Electrical, Instrumentation, and Controls Manufacturing
jobs.description_text: As Manager of Electrical, Instrumentation, and Controls (EI&C) Manufacturing, you will apply your skills leading a team of engineers and technicians in Manufacturing and integrating cutting edge electrical, instrumentation, and controls hardware for our large laser systems. You will be a player-coach who leads the team and performs hands-on EI&C work and technical mentoring. As we transition towards building at rate, you will take a leading role in standing up a new work center to scale production rates through innovative manufacturing technique development and through automation. You will also lead the team to provide collaborative Design for Manufacturing (DFM) input to the design teams and work to build seamless partnerships across the teams. We are looking for our Manager of Electrical, Instrumentation, and Controls Manufacturing to apply their technical expertise, problem solving skills, and dedication to quality to positively impact the future of energy!

jobs.title: Mechanical Engineer
jobs.description_text: As a Mechanical Engineer, you will play a critical role in the design, analysis, build, and operation of laser, pulsed power, vacuum vessel, and ancillary mechanical systems that are central to Xcimer’s excimer‑laser‑based IFE technology. You will contribute across the full product lifecycle—from early prototype systems through the design and demonstration of a power‑producing inertial fusion reactor. We are seeking engineers who bring strong technical depth, hands‑on problem-solving skills, and a passion for building high‑performance hardware that will redefine the future of energy.

jobs.title: Mechanical Engineer - Pulsed Power
jobs.description_text: As a Mechanical Engineer - Pulsed Power, you will lead the design, integration, and operation of high voltage pulsed power systems for lasers used in IFE power generation. Your work will begin with prototype systems and continue through the design and demonstration of power-producing IFE reactors. You will ensure that pulsed power hardware meets performance requirements throughout the product development lifecycle in a dynamic R&D environment. We are looking for our engineers to apply their technical expertise, problem solving skills, and dedication to quality to positively impact the future of energy! Open to level 2-4 depending on qualifications.

jobs.title: Mechanical Engineer / Senior Mechanical Engineer, Opto-Mechanics
jobs.description_text: Xcimer Energy builds on decades of research in Inertial Fusion Energy (IFE), combined with a groundbreaking new laser architecture, to accelerate the deployment of fusion power plants. Xcimer has assembled a world-class team spanning tough tech, fusion science, and advanced manufacturing, with a proven track record of rapid execution. Every mirror, window, lens, and diagnostic in Xcimer's deep-UV laser system depends on mechanical hardware that holds it precisely, keeps it stable, and lets us align and maintain it. We are looking for mechanical engineers with sound design fundamentals and an interest in opto-mechanics to design, build, and test that hardware. You will work across the full lifecycle: requirements, concept, analysis, drawings, procurement, assembly, alignment, and test. This is a hands-on role where you will spend time in the optics labs, cleanrooms and manufacturing floors. We are hiring at multiple levels, from engineers with a few years of solid design experience who want to deepen their opto-mechanics expertise, to senior engineers who can lead subsystem designs and mentor others.

jobs.title: Optical Engineer
jobs.description_text: Xcimer is looking for an Optical Engineer to help us build state-of-the-art UV laser systems for laser driven inertial fusion. We are a small, dynamic, and highly motivated team focused on the most plausible path to bringing fusion to the grid. You will have the opportunity to apply broad optical engineering skills and technical leadership to complex problems, and directly contribute to the design, build, and test of our laser and diagnostic systems. We are looking for our engineers to apply their technical expertise, problem solving skills, and dedication to quality to positively impact the future of energy!

jobs.title: Optical Manufacturing Engineer
jobs.description_text: Join our team as a Optics Manufacturing Engineer, where you'll optimize production of optical assemblies, vessels, diagnostics, and potentially lenses and mirrors, for quality and throughput. Your role will involve translating engineering designs into fully operational hardware, optimizing existing production lines, and ensuring top-notch quality standards. You will do this primarily through work instruction authoring, manufacturing training development and coaching, as well as through hands on assistance and hands on build. You will also drive continuous improvement of quality and throughput, driving and executing needed manufacturing and product changes. You will also serve as the first point of contact for the production teams when they escalate a technical issues. Embrace the opportunity to work on cutting-edge technology aimed at revolutionizing energy production. We are looking for our engineers to apply their technical expertise, problem solving skills, and dedication to quality to positively impact the future of energy.

jobs.title: Optical Operations Technician
jobs.description_text: Xcimer Energy leverages decades of research on Inertial Fusion Energy (IFE) combined with groundbreaking new laser architecture. Our mission is to deploy fusion power plants to meet global decarbonization goals as fast as possible. Xcimer has assembled a team of leaders in tough tech, fusion science, and manufacturing with a track record of rapid execution. Supported by leading investors, Xcimer is uniquely positioned to deliver limitless, clean, fusion power to combat climate change. Join us in powering a better world with inertial fusion! This is a full-time, onsite role based at our headquarters in Denver, CO. As an Optical Operations Technician, you will apply your skills in optical assembly and alignment to deliver fusion energy. We are looking for our technicians to apply their technical expertise, problem solving skills, and dedication to quality to positively impact the future of energy! Candidates may be considered for other positions at Xcimer Energy, and our actual base salary will be determined on an individual basis and may vary based on job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience. The range is published in accordance with Colorado Equal Pay for Equal Work Act and California Equal Pay Act.

jobs.title: Principal Electro-Optical/Adaptive Optics Engineer, Directed Energy
jobs.description_text: Xcimer’s Directed Energy programs apply the high-energy pulsed laser technology behind our fusion work to national security problems. We are seeking a Principal Electro-Optical/Adaptive Optics Engineer to serve as the adaptive optics and wavefront control authority for a directed-energy laser demonstrator. You will own the adaptive optics requirements, the performance budgets that justify them, and the plan and resources that implement them. You will be a primary technical interface for items such as: negotiating requirements and interfaces, reviewing partner designs and ours against the same performance model, and contributing to a shared development effort rather than handing off a specification. Xcimer’s central goal is commercial fusion, and this role carries technology in both directions. Beam control lessons from the Directed Energy program feed directly into our fusion beamlines, where the same deep-UV wavefront and pointing problems reappear at a different scale and duty cycle. You will help set the beam control direction for fusion on the strength of what you deliver on Directed Energy. Additionally, we are building the adaptive optics group. You will help set the technical standards and development practices it works to, mentor the engineers and scientists in it, and take on technology development that outlives any single program. We move on real hardware quickly. We want the governing equations and a first-order layout before money is committed, and we want a cheap

jobs.title: Production Supervisor, Wound Film Capacitors
jobs.description_text: As a Production Supervisor, you will own the safety, quality, and output of the wound film capacitor line at our Tucson, Arizona facility — the capacitors that store and deliver the energy behind Xcimer's pulsed-power laser drivers. We are looking for a production leader to apply their technical expertise, problem solving skills, and dedication to quality to positively impact the future of energy!

jobs.title: Program Director, Plant Control Systems
jobs.description_text: As the Program Director, Plant Control Systems, you will serve as the program-level owner for the Plant Control System within Xcimer’s IFE Fusion Plant architecture. In this role, you will provide program leadership, integration direction, requirement ownership, and cross-functional coordination to ensure that all Plant Control System sub-elements, and all other Fusion Plant elements, work together coherently within a unified control framework. You will partner closely with technical architects and Subject Matter Experts, subsystem engineers, and other Program Directors to ensure alignment to top-level requirements, interfaces, safety expectations, operational needs, and program milestones. This role requires exceptional systems thinking, cross-element collaboration, and the ability to guide teams without direct line authority.

jobs.title: Pulsed Power Manufacturing Engineer
jobs.description_text: Join our team as a Pulsed Power Manufacturing Engineer, where you'll optimize production of pulsed power assemblies and integrated products, for quality and throughput. Your role will involve translating engineering designs into fully operational hardware, optimizing existing production lines, and ensuring top-notch quality standards. You will do this primarily through work instruction authoring, manufacturing training development and coaching, as well as through hands on assistance and hands on build. You will also drive continuous improvement of quality and throughput, driving and executing needed manufacturing and product changes. You will also serve as the first point of contact for the production teams when they escalate technical issues. Embrace the opportunity to work on cutting-edge technology aimed at revolutionizing energy production. We are looking for our engineers to apply their technical expertise, problem solving skills, and dedication to quality to positively impact the future of energy.

jobs.title: Pulsed Power Operations Engineer
jobs.description_text: As a Pulsed Power Operations Engineer, you will apply your technical and operational skills to operating, troubleshooting, and maintaining the pulsed power components in a state-of-the-art laser system. You will learn from our pulsed power subject matter experts as you troubleshoot system anomalies, disposition non-conformances, and perform engineering work to implement system upgrades and improvements. You’ll author system operating procedures and build out other operational infrastructure for the experimental Phoenix system, such as: alarm setpoints, interlocks, preventive maintenance requirements, and data analysis tools. You will also be one of the first to formally qualify to operate the system. Once qualified, you will serve as Pulsed Power Controller – interacting with our control interface and working with the Shot Director to execute critical procedures in our laser experiment operations. During maintenance and upgrade operations, you will also perform hands on work on the system to troubleshoot, perform corrective and preventive maintenance, and execute system upgrades. We are looking for our pulsed power operations engineers to apply their technical expertise, problem solving skills, and dedication to quality to positively impact the future of energy!

jobs.title: Senior Manufacturing Engineer, Capacitor Production
jobs.description_text: As a Senior Manufacturing Engineer, you will own the health of the manufacturing processes running on Xcimer's wound film capacitor line in Tucson, Arizona — the capacitors that store and deliver the energy behind Xcimer's pulsed-power laser drivers. This is a floor-facing process engineering role on a line that is building product today and scaling toward rate. We are looking for an engineer who is relentless about quality, insistent about following process, and energized by making a running line measurably better every week.

jobs.title: Senior Molten Salt Scientist
jobs.description_text: The successful candidate will be responsible for building the company’s technical capability in Flibe (Li₂BeF₄) and other molten salts, including chemistry control, materials compatibility, corrosion, thermophysical properties, tritium behavior, impurity control, salt processing, and measurements/instrumentation for advancing the technology development of our fusion plant power systems. This individual will lead the design, commissioning, and management of the Molten Salt laboratory, establish experimental capabilities and procedures, and develop a research program that directly informs the design and operation of the company's fusion power plant. The role will work closely with other science departments and with engineering teams to translate experimental results into requirements and design solutions. The ideal candidate will combine deep technical expertise in molten salts with hands-on laboratory experience and the ability to establish a new experimental capability from the ground up.

jobs.title: Senior Opto-Mechanical Engineer, Large Optics Structures
jobs.description_text: Xcimer Energy builds on decades of research in Inertial Fusion Energy (IFE), combined with a groundbreaking new laser architecture, to accelerate the deployment of fusion power plants. Xcimer has assembled a world-class team spanning tough tech, fusion science, and advanced manufacturing, with a proven track record of rapid execution. Xcimer's laser architecture transports high-energy deep-UV beams through meter-class, segmented mirror arrays. The optical performance of the entire system depends on how well those mirrors are held: mount-induced stress, thermal gradients, gravity sag, and facility vibration all couple directly as degraded beam quality for our lasers. You will own the mounting concepts and the supporting structures for our largest optics, from first principles through installed, measured hardware. This is a hands-on senior role where you will spend time in the optics labs and on the integration floor, and you will be a technical leader on a small, fast-moving team.

jobs.title: Summer 2027 Internship - Computational and Software Engineering
jobs.description_text: Join Xcimer’s engineering internship program and gain hands-on experience in designing and building cutting-edge laser-driven inertial fusion hardware and software. As an intern, you will be integral to developing the systems needed for the world’s first commercial fusion energy power plant. We have multiple internship opportunities available across various disciplines, including Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Physics, and Software Development. Please apply to the posting that best matches your background and interests. During this 12-week program at our headquarters in Denver, CO, you’ll work alongside an industry expert mentor to tackle complex, real-world challenges in fields such as structures, mechanisms, optics, pulsed power, computational engineering, plasma physics, and manufacturing. We are seeking interns who are passionate about applying their technical skills, problem-solving abilities, and commitment to quality to drive the future of clean energy! Application close date: 12/31/2026

jobs.title: Systems Engineer IV
jobs.description_text: As a Systems Engineer IV , you will be a thought leader in Xcimer influencing and educating technical leads to capture, organize, and track the integrated technical baseline for our IFE Program. The successful candidate will perform leading and supporting roles in establishing and maintaining bidirectional traceability across our requirements, architecture, documentation, and analysis products. The candidate will define and maintain infrastructure, define relationships between internal and external interfaces, and communicate system-level use cases and relationships to a diverse group of stakeholders. The candidate will work with team leads across the organization to craft the key framework and documents needed to define, design, build, test, and activate our facilities and systems. We are looking for engineers to apply their technical expertise, problem solving skills, and dedication to quality to positively impact the future of energy!

jobs.title: Technical Project Manager, DOE Partnerships
jobs.description_text: As a Technical Project Manager, DOE Partnerships, you will support Xcimer’s public-private partnerships with the U.S. Department of Energy as we design, build, and test the experimental facilities and run the numerical investigations that lead to our fusion pilot plant. You will apply your project management skills to coordinate proposals and milestone reporting, manage cost and schedule performance, and help keep our DOE-funded work on track. As part of the Inertial Fusion Energy (IFE) program team, you will work closely with technical leads to translate program requirements into actionable schedules, track progress across concurrent workstreams, and surface risks before they threaten deliverables. We are looking for a project manager who is comfortable coordinating both internal engineering teams and outside consultants to deliver complex technical scope, and who can pick up new technical domains quickly, going deep enough to ask the right questions and spot problems early. In this role, you’ll help manage the partnerships that take Xcimer’s fusion pilot plant from design to reality.

jobs.title: Vacuum Systems Mechanical Engineer
jobs.description_text: As a Vacuum Systems Mechanical Engineer, you will lead the design, integration, and operation of vacuum systems for rare-gas/halide (excimer) lasers used in IFE power generation. Your work will begin with prototype systems and continue through the design and demonstration of power-producing IFE reactors. You will ensure that vacuum hardware meets flow and performance requirements throughout the product development lifecycle in a dynamic R&D environment. We are looking for our engineers to apply their technical expertise, problem solving skills, and dedication to quality to positively impact the future of energy!

jobs.title: AI Security Software Engineer (Starshield)
jobs.description_text: AI SECURITY SOFTWARE ENGINEER (STARSHIELD) AI is rapidly transforming the national security landscape. SpaceX needs to lead the way by developing AI solutions to solve the most pressing security problems. We can no longer respond at human speed in order to counter threats from adversaries — it is critical that we develop solutions to deal with this problem now. As an engineer on the newly formed AI security team, you will develop AI-powered automation and platforms to identify and fix vulnerabilities, perform real-time detections/investigations/network defense, and more. This team heavily leverages AI for fast-paced development and rollout, while also ensuring that these AI security tools can be highly trusted and secure themselves. If you are passionate about AI, software, and security this role is for you. Prior security engineering experience is preferred but not required. A great candidate has experience and/or deep enthusiasm for AI, agent engineering, robust software system design, and network and systems security. jobs.title: Application Software Engineer, Employee Experience
jobs.description_text: APPLICATION SOFTWARE ENGINEER, EMPLOYEE EXPERIENCE The application software team is the central nervous system of SpaceX – we create mission critical applications that are used throughout SpaceX to accelerate launch vehicle production and flight as well as systems that allow Starlink to grow into a worldwide fast, reliable Internet service. We are looking for engineers who treat fellow teammates with fairness, respect, and support. Our team is currently creating and evolving systems to enable rapid build and reuse of Starship as well as designing the next generation manufacturing software that will be used in high throughput factories for Starlink. We work closely with engineers throughout the company to create and update our systems with respect to crewed launches, Starship flights, changes to the Starlink network and much more. Aerospace experience is not required to be successful here - rather we look for smart, motivated, respectful, collaborative engineers who love solving problems and want to make an impact on a super inspiring mission. This role requires advanced technical expertise, leadership, and coordination across multiple teams to ensure mission-critical operations are executed flawlessly. The specialist is a proactive leader who drives safety, mentors team members, and implements innovative solutions to enhance team performance and system reliability. jobs.description_text: CRITICAL LIFT & TRANSPORT ENGINEER (STARSHIP) SpaceX is currently seeking an individual to join the launch site engineering team in Cape Canaveral, FL. Specifically, you will be responsible for ensuring all aspects of critical transport and lift operations for our Starship and Super Heavy booster vehicles, as well as ground support equipment, have been properly designed, reviewed, and carried out. You will be responsible for addressing complex structural, civil, and mechanical issues that arise and utilizing engineering intuition as well as thorough calculation to provide engineering disposition for the path forward. RESPONSIBILITIES: Plan, analyze, and execute critical lifts and heavy-haul transports for large-scale hardware (e.g., rocket stages, ground support equipment, or structural components), ensuring compliance with safety standards, regulations (e.g., OSHA, ASME B30), and engineering best practices. jobs.title: Data Engineer (Starlink Mobile)
jobs.description_text: DATA ENGINEER (STARLINK MOBILE) The Starlink Mobile network will expand Starlink’s vision by providing ubiquitous connectivity and seamless access to text, voice, and data for LTE phones and devices across the globe. The Starlink Mobile network leverages the infrastructure we’ve built for Starlink over the past several years. Starlink is the world’s largest satellite constellation and is providing fast, reliable internet to 7M+ users worldwide. As the global leader in rocket and satellite launch and manufacturing, SpaceX is uniquely positioned to rapidly scale our Mobile network and will rapidly launch a constellation of hundreds of satellites. jobs.title: Development Test Engineer (Starlink)
jobs.description_text: DEVELOPMENT TEST ENGINEER (STARLINK) SpaceX is leveraging its experience in building rockets and spacecraft to deploy Starlink, the world’s most advanced broadband internet system. Starlink is the world’s largest satellite constellation and is providing fast, reliable internet to millions of users worldwide. We design, build, test, and operate all parts of the system – thousands of satellites, consumer receivers that allow users to connect within minutes of unboxing, and the software that brings it all together. We’ve only begun to scratch the surface of Starlink’s potential global impact. As we continue to upgrade and expand the constellation, we’re looking for best-in-class engineers to join the team. jobs.description_text: FLUIDS ENGINEER, PRODUCTION (STARSHIP) Starship is the largest and most capable space launch system ever developed. jobs.description_text: FPGA/ASIC DESIGN ENGINEER (SILICON ENGINEERING) At SpaceX we’re leveraging our experience in building rockets and spacecraft to deploy Starlink, the world’s most advanced broadband internet system. We design, build, test, and operate all parts of the system – thousands of satellites, consumer receivers that allow users to connect within minutes of unboxing, and the software that brings it all together. In this role, you will be developing cutting-edge next-generation FPGAs and ASICs for deployment in space and ground infrastructures around the globe. These chips are enabling connectivity in places it has previously not been available, affordable or reliable. Your efforts will help deliver cutting-edge solutions that will expand the performance and capabilities of the Starlink network. While Starlink is designed for consumer and commercial use, Starshield is designed for government use, with an initial focus on earth observation, communications, and hosted payloads. The satellite engineering team is hiring for satellite programs that are pushing the boundaries of in-space capabilities. Our missions support scientific research, classified national security space and commercial opportunities. Software engineering and innovation is at the core of these programs. The satellite software team is building highly reliable in-space networks, designing secure systems to guarantee access to space, and creating autonomous satellite operation systems, and more. Aerospace experience is not required to be successful here - we want our engineers to bring fresh ideas from all areas, love solving problems, and seek to make an impact on an inspiring mission. As we expand this team, we're looking for versatile, driven, and collaborative engineers. The team is making a next generation machine shop with advanced software and automation, an alien dreadnought machine that builds the machine. As a software engineer, you will design novel software solutions such as web applications for efficient factory operation, algorithms and AI to automatically create CNC programs, control and deployment of CNC machines, and much more. These improvements will enable rapid Starship production rates of 100+ per year as well as a quick development cycle, which are critical for SpaceX’s Moon and Mars missions. Previous manufacturing experience is not necessary, just the desire to make high-quality software to rapidly build Starships. jobs.title: Full Stack Software Engineer, Internal Systems
jobs.description_text: FULL STACK SOFTWARE ENGINEER, INTERNAL SYSTEMS The application software team is the central nervous system of SpaceX – we create mission critical applications that are used throughout SpaceX to accelerate launch vehicle production and flight as well as systems that allow Starlink to grow into a worldwide fast, reliable Internet service. We are looking for engineers who treat fellow teammates with fairness, respect, and support. Our team is currently creating and evolving systems to enable rapid build and reuse of Starship as well as designing the next generation manufacturing software that will be used in high throughput factories for Starlink. Other applications range from platforms that support concurrent streams of data from many always-on assets to manage the world’s largest satellite constellation to public facing systems where customers can join our Starlink network globally. We work closely with engineers throughout the company to create and update our systems with respect to crewed launches, Starship flights, changes to the Starlink network and much more. Aerospace experience is not required to be successful here - rather we look for smart, motivated, respectful, collaborative engineers who love solving problems and want to make an impact on a super inspiring mission. You will have full ownership of challenging problems, working with a team of enthusiastic engineers with diverse perspectives to design and produce solutions that enable SpaceX to move towards our goals
